description:
Title: New Application for Registering for an USI course

If you want to register for a course at the sports institute, you need to select a course.
If slots are free, the system tells you the courses, and dates.
Select one.
Next, you need to check if you already have an account at the sports institute.
If not, you need to check whether you are registered at an eligible university.
If you are, register your account.
If you are not, request an activation and wait for a response.
As soon as you have an account, log into it.
The application is also connected to your twitter account, and lets you tweet to friends who might want to join you, you can complete the registration for the course and provide the payment information.
In the end, you will receive a course ticket.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_USI_CourseRegistration" targetNamespace="http://sports-institute.example/bpmn/course-registration">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_USI_CourseRegistration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ApplicationStart" name="Registration for course wanted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectCourse</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select course">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectCourse</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectCourse_SlotsCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsFree" name="Slots free?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectCourse_SlotsCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SlotsFree_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SlotsFree_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoSlots" name="No slots available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SlotsFree_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates" name="Show courses and dates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SlotsFree_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShowCourses_SelectDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourseDate" name="Select course date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShowCourses_SelectDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectDate_CheckAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check for existing account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectDate_CheckAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckAccount_AccountCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasAccount" name="Has account at sports institute?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckAccount_AccountCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasAccount_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasAccount_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CheckEligibility" name="Check registration at eligible university">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasAccount_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckEligibility_EligibilityCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" name="Registered at eligible university?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckEligibility_EligibilityCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EligibleUni_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EligibleUni_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EligibleUni_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterAccount_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EligibleUni_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestActivation_Response</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestActivation_Response</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Response_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ActivationResponse" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountReady" name="Account available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasAccount_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterAccount_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Response_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountReady_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountReady_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Split application activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_TweetFriends</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends via Twitter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_TweetFriends</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TweetFriends_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration and provide payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteRegistration_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Activities completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TweetFriends_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompleteRegistration_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_IssueTicket</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueCourseTicket" name="Issue course ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_IssueTicket</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IssueTicket_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TicketReceived" name="Course ticket received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IssueTicket_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectCourse" sourceRef="StartEvent_ApplicationStart" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectCourse_SlotsCheck" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsFree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsFree_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsFree" targetRef="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${slotsFree == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsFree_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsFree" targetRef="EndEvent_NoSlots">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${slotsFree == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowCourses_SelectDate" sourceRef="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourseDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectDate_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourseDate" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_AccountCheck" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_HasAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasAccount == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount" targetRef="Task_CheckEligibility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasAccount == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckEligibility_EligibilityCheck" sourceRef="Task_CheckEligibility" targetRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EligibleUni_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${eligibleUniversity == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EligibleUni_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${eligibleUniversity == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterAccount_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestActivation_Response" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Response_Merge" sourceRef="Event_ActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountReady_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountReady" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_TweetFriends" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CompleteRegistration" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetFriends_Join" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteRegistration_Join" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_IssueTicket" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_IssueCourseTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueTicket_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueCourseTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_TicketReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
